name: Broome County, NY
findings: Broome County has 723 nonprofit organizations. 354 of them (49%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 308 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Broome County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
